context.description: Step 03: Design and write integration tests for IDN-05 Named role registry.

task.description:
Write a test spec and integration tests for IDN-05. All MUST acceptance criteria must have a runnable integration test. Required test cases:

TC-IDN05-01: POST /roles creates a binding — given a valid name + group_id that exists in the tenant, POST /roles returns 201 and a JSON body with id/name/group_id/created_at.

TC-IDN05-02: POST /roles with unknown group_id returns 404 GROUP_NOT_FOUND.

TC-IDN05-03: POST /roles upserts — binding same role name twice with different group_ids succeeds (idempotent update), second call returns 200.

TC-IDN05-04: GET /roles lists all bindings for the calling tenant.

TC-IDN05-05: Tenant isolation — role name registered in tenant A is invisible to GET /roles on tenant B.

TC-IDN05-06: ROLE assignee resolution at task activation — given a HUMAN_TASK node with assignee_type=ROLE whose assignee_ref has a binding in the registry, when the node activates (EE-03), the Task is created with GROUP semantics (group_id set).

TC-IDN05-07: ROLE assignee unresolved — given a HUMAN_TASK node with assignee_type=ROLE whose assignee_ref has NO binding, when the node activates, the Task is created in PENDING status (not ERROR).

Write test spec to tests/specs/IDN-05.md and integration test code following the same patterns as other integration tests in tests/. Wire the test binary/step in build.zig. No SkipZigTest on MUST tests. Fixtures must be isolated (no shared state between tests).

Verify: python tools/lint_test_isolation.py exits 0 and python tools/lint_handoffs.py exits 0.

result.summary: REWORK-1/3: Fixed TSDV-IDN05-01 BLOCKER. TC-IDN05-05 now provisions a fresh tenant B schema via provisionTenantSchema, acquires a connection routed to that schema, queries COUNT(*) FROM tenant_role WHERE name = role_name, and asserts the result is 0. The prior deferred comment and `_ = count` discard are removed. lint_test_isolation.py exits 0 (baseline line updated for 2-line import addition). lint_handoffs.py exits 0 after handoff completion. Compiled with zig build, committed to feature/WF02-idn05-20260812 (91f1f3d6).
